text: The Nominating Panel - Corporations will select candidates to be interviewed for appointment to the CreateTO Board. The Nominating Panel will conduct interviews at its next meeting and recommend one candidate to City Council for appointment.

The Nominating Panel - Corporations: 1. Selected the following candidates for interview for appointment to the CreateTO Board: Candidate TRB2-340 Candidate TRB2-345 Candidate TRB2-353 Candidate TRB2-359 Candidate TRB2-364 Candidate TRB2-386 Candidate TRB2-392 2. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 and 2 to the report (January 23, 2024) from the City Clerk remain confidential in its entirety as it relates to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the CreateTO Board.
